newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean health minister resigns amid bribery probe.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean health minister resigns amid bribery probe.

text.p: South Korean President Kim Young-sam on Wednesday accepted the resignation of his health minister amid state media reports that the minister's wife is being investigated over allegations of bribery.
Lee Sung-ho, Minister of Health and Welfare, had submitted his resignation on Tuesday, a presidential Blue House spokesman said.
President Kim appointed a member of parliament for the ruling New Korea party, Sohn Hak-kyu, to replace Lee, the Blue House spokesman said.

State radio and television reported that Lee's wife, Park Sung-ae, was summonded by prosecutors on Tuesday night for questioning over allegations that she received 100 million won ($120,000) in bribes from an opticians' trade group as part of its lobbying efforts.
The Korea Broadcasting System said prosecutors planned to summon Lee as well. Prosecution officials were not immediately available for comment.
Lee is the second government minister to leave his post in a cloud in less than a month. Former Defence Minister Lee Yang-ho was sacked on October 17 and was formally indicted on Monday.
